architecture.backend: Serverless Python API deployed on Vercel.
architecture.context_strategy: Direct injection of structured knowledge into build_system_instruction().
architecture.retrieval_strategy: Direct context injection without a vector database or RAG layer.
architecture.response_delivery: Streaming model responses through the serverless API to a JavaScript chat interface.

details.context: A static portfolio can present professional information but cannot independently answer detailed follow-up questions about experience, projects, engineering decisions, and technical capabilities.
details.engineering_challenge: Build a personal AI representative that can answer recruiter questions using documented information without inventing experience, project details, or technical achievements.
details.what_i_built: A Gemini-powered AI agent connected to a serverless Python backend, a curated JSON knowledge base, and a streaming JavaScript chat interface.
details.technical_decisions: Used structured JSON as a compact source of truth and injected its contents directly into the system instruction. Avoided unnecessary vector database infrastructure because the curated knowledge base could be supplied directly.
details.grounding_strategy: The agent uses documented identity, technical skills, experience, project details, and contact information. Its knowledge boundaries instruct it not to invent missing information.
details.streaming_implementation: Uses Gemini generate_content_stream(), server-side chunk flushing, and browser-side TextDecoder processing.
details.security_considerations: Keeps model credentials on the server side and uses explicit grounding instructions to reduce unsupported responses.
validation_focus: Grounded answers based on documented facts
details.reported_performance: Approximately 400 ms to the first response chunk, as reported in project measurements. This is an observed measurement, not a guaranteed service-level objective.
details.lessons_learned: A useful AI agent needs more than a capable language model. Curated context, explicit knowledge boundaries, and controlled response delivery are essential to making its answers dependable.

details.context: Retail point-of-sale system serving 10 businesses where transaction latency and operational stability affected checkout workflows.
details.engineering_challenge: Support reliable transaction workflows while maintaining financial and inventory data consistency.
details.what_i_built: Contributed to the CPOS system, with the portfolio's experience description limited to the verified scope of my actual contribution.
details.technical_decisions: Prioritized explicit execution paths and input validation at service boundaries.
details.reliability_considerations: Data consistency and predictable transaction behavior were central engineering concerns.
details.outcome: The supplied project record reports 10 retail businesses and 25% faster transaction processing.
details.lessons_learned: Performance improvements are only valuable when the underlying transaction execution remains consistent and predictable.

details.context: An e-commerce client issuing rapid concurrent HTTP requests during active user interaction.
details.engineering_challenge: Late-arriving responses could overwrite newer client state with outdated information.
details.what_i_built: A request-ordering guard that compares response freshness against sequential request counters before allowing state mutations.
details.technical_decisions: Separated network arrival timing from state mutation authority and rejected stale responses.
details.reliability_considerations: Treated network delays and out-of-order responses as expected runtime conditions.
details.outcome: Addressed the state corruption scenario caused by out-of-order responses. Quantitative production metrics remain unmeasured.
details.lessons_learned: Asynchronous state correctness requires explicit authority over which response is allowed to commit.

details.context: Independent technical delivery of client services involving APIs, relational storage, and containerized deployments.
details.engineering_challenge: Translate business requirements into maintainable backend services with predictable data contracts.
details.what_i_built: Backend services, relational database schemas, and REST endpoints using Django, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
details.technical_decisions: Applied schema validation, separated environment configuration, and used Docker for runtime consistency.
details.reliability_considerations: Focused on API input validation, predictable error handling, and database migration discipline.
details.outcome: The supplied project record reports 6+ delivered applications and microservices.
details.lessons_learned: Even small services require explicit API contracts to remain dependable as their dependencies evolve.

case_studies.title: Resilient Data Ingestion Pipeline (The Polite Scraper)

details.context: Fault-tolerant web crawler designed to extract, clean, and structure catalog data from HTML sources while respecting remote hosts.
details.engineering_challenge: Avoid unnecessary repeated network requests while enforcing request limits and validating extracted data.
details.what_i_built: An ETL pipeline featuring local SHA-256 caching, request delays, network timeout bounds, and Pydantic validation.
details.technical_decisions: Used lightweight HTML parsing instead of resource-heavy browser automation and standardized prices and timestamps.
details.reliability_considerations: Cached content bypasses remote network calls on subsequent executions.
details.outcome: Processed 60 records across 3 pages in 2.82 seconds, with 63 out of 63 cache hits on the reported re-execution.
details.lessons_learned: External HTTP sources must be treated as untrusted, and data validation should happen immediately at the ingestion boundary.

details.context: A multi-stage REST API project evolving from in-memory and SQLite prototypes to PostgreSQL persistence and JWT authentication.
details.engineering_challenge: Implement authentication boundaries and reproducible application and database environments.
details.what_i_built: A FastAPI service with Supabase JWT validation, Bearer token authorization, and a multi-container Docker environment.
details.technical_decisions: Separated configuration into environment variables and orchestrated API and database services using Docker Compose.
details.reliability_considerations: Used Pydantic validation and explicit HTTP error responses for invalid requests and unauthorized access.
details.outcome: Built a containerized authenticated task service with documented authentication flows.
details.lessons_learned: Authentication, session behavior, and error handling need deliberate design rather than being treated as secondary implementation details.

details.context: A live website built independently for a dental and implant centre to present services and provide a channel for patient inquiries.
details.engineering_challenge: Create a responsive and accessible client-facing website with predictable inquiry form interactions.
details.what_i_built: A responsive commercial website for Princeton Dental & Implant Centre.
details.technical_decisions: Used a lightweight frontend implementation with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
details.reliability_considerations: Focused on clear form interactions and appropriate client-side input handling.
details.lessons_learned: Reliable client-facing experiences depend on clear user flows and predictable input handling.

details.context: An experimental side project generated through targeted LLM prompts to explore AI-assisted code generation.
details.engineering_challenge: Evaluate boundary conditions where generated code can fail in state-machine and rendering workflows.
details.what_i_built: A browser-based Canvas game featuring collision detection, score evaluation, and game-loop updates.
details.technical_decisions: Constrained implementation to vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas without external frameworks.
details.reliability_considerations: Reviewed generated state transitions and boundary conditions to identify possible collision and timing issues.
details.lessons_learned: AI can accelerate implementation, but generated code still requires engineering review to preserve state invariants.
